name: Velmar
owner: A client's brand; visual system built by Ignacio for the demo
idea: A two-peaked M over a V, cut at 45°: objects made to order for the home and the pet.
place: The demo of a made-to-order shop, in Mar del Plata

display.role: Editorial headlines and the name in the logo
display.sample: Objects made to order for your home and your pet

text.role: Interface text and labels in capitals
text.sample: Pick the piece, add their name and we make it for you, in Mar del Plata.

grid: Every stroke runs at 45° with the same thickness: that thickness is the module.
The M ends where the V begins: one horizontal line splits the mark into two halves.
One module of air sits between the M and the V; another surrounds the mark.

alt.logo: Velmar logo: a two-peaked M over a V, in olive green, and the name
alt.secondary: Stacked version: the monogram, the name Velmar and Mar del Plata
alt.submark: Velmar monogram: the M over the V
alt.patterns: Three patterns: chevrons on paper, the monogram in brass and an olive quilt
alt.post: Sample post: an olive collar with a brass tag that reads Lola
alt.story: Sample story: an order in three steps, on olive green
alt.poster: Sample poster: the monogram in brass with a tag hanging from the V
alt.print: Sample hang tag, with the name Lola written by hand
alt.object: Shipping box in 3D: cardboard, the logo in one ink and olive green tape

source: The logo is the client's brand; colours and type are the demo's provisional palette. Grid, patterns, pieces and box were drawn for the board.
